description: Gares de voyageurs Nouvelle Aquitaine is a dataset listed in opendata.pau.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gares & Connexions. Référentiel SNCF Gares&Connexions des gares de voyageurs Définition du "segment DRG": Catégorie A: gares de voyageurs d’intérêt national. Ces gares sont celles dont la fréquentation par des voyageurs des services nationaux et internationaux de voyageurs est au moins égale à 250 000 voyageurs par an ou dont ces mêmes voyageurs représentent 100% des voyageurs. Coverage: Pau agglomeration. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Gare de voyageurs, Gares de voyageurs, Gares, gare, Géolocalisation, Code UIC. The portal shows 31 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-10-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-pau-fr-portal.
